global_context_layer.name: WHO Global Road-Safety Context v1
global_context_layer.source_title: Global status report on road safety 2023: country and territory profiles
global_context_layer.reported_coverage: 170 Member States and 2 territories; nearly 100 indicators per profile

international_regulatory_layer.name: UNECE international automated-driving regulatory context
international_regulatory_layer.source_title: UN Regulation No. 157 - Automated Lane Keeping Systems
international_regulatory_layer.recording_rule: Record instrument, version, accession/adoption and explicitly established domestic applicability. Do not classify a domestic action from an international instrument unless applicability is documented in the Deep-Law record.

deep_law_layer.scope: Primary-law, scenario-relevant rules only; initial categories are pedestrian priority, lane markings, overtaking, collision-avoidance/necessity exceptions, and stopped or disabled vehicles.
deep_law_layer.admission_rule: A jurisdiction enters the frozen analytical subset only after every included rule has an official primary source or official legal database record, stable locator, retrieval date, source language, effective-date state, scenario/action applicability, and explicit review/uncertainty state.
deep_law_layer.unknown_law_rule: No evidence, stale evidence, unresolved translation, or unestablished applicability must produce NOT_DETERMINED or an equivalent explicit unknown state, never permission.
